findings.evidence: The only occurrences of the specialization are the signature and `set F := fixedField (Subgroup.zpowers g)` at lines 35–39; thereafter the proof uses only `fixingSubgroup_fixedField` and the meet hypothesis, both of which apply to an arbitrary subgroup (`Mathlib/FieldTheory/Galois/Basic.lean:273`).
findings.fix: First prove the natural theorem for `(H : Subgroup (M ≃ₐ[K] M))`, assuming `H ⊓ (adjoin K {b | b ^ m = 1}).fixingSubgroup = ⊥` and concluding `IsCyclotomicExtension {m} (fixedField H) M`; derive the `zpowers g` form as a corollary if the roadmap needs it.
findings.issue: The theorem specializes its subgroup to `Subgroup.zpowers g`, although the argument and conclusion do not use cyclicity or the generator.

summary: The proof is unnecessarily restricted to cyclic subgroups; every step works for an arbitrary subgroup of the Galois group.
